title: A 557% profit jump couldn't save SK Hynix from an earnings-day slump — or the Kospi from a rout
excerpt: Record corporate profits aren't stopping investors from taking money off the table as retail traders pile into South Korean stocks.
content_html:
By Huileng Tan

You're currently following this author! Want to unfollow? Unsubscribe via the link in your email.

A 557% profit jump wasn't enough to satisfy SK Hynix investors, underscoring how lofty expectations have become for companies at the heart of the artificial intelligence boom.

Shares of the South Korean memory-chip maker fell as much as 20% before closing nearly 10% lower after it reported record second-quarter earnings that fell short of analysts' forecasts.

SK Hynix posted revenue of 79.3 trillion South Korean won, or about $54.6 billion, up 257% from a year earlier. Operating profit surged 557% to 60.5 trillion won, while net profit jumped 1,242% to 93.9 trillion won. All three were quarterly records.

Nasdaq-listed SK Hynix ADRs closed 9% lower on Tuesday and were about 4% lower in pre-market trade at 4:00 a.m. ET on Wednesday.

The company benefited from rising prices and strong demand for high-bandwidth memory, or HBM, and other chips used in AI servers. Still, revenue and operating profit missed analysts' expectations, with operating profit falling short of a roughly 64 trillion won consensus forecast.

The sell-off in the index heavyweight dragged South Korea's benchmark Kospi down about 6%, while shares of rival Samsung Electronics fell about 5%.

The weakness spread to chip stocks across Asia as investors reassessed lofty AI-driven valuations. Japan's Kioxia fell 14%, while Taiwan Semiconductor Manufacturing Co. ended about 4% lower.

South Korean authorities are planning an emergency meeting on Wednesday evening to review the market volatility.

Earlier that same day, the country's finance minister and top financial regulator apologized for the introduction of single-stock leveraged ETFs that have contributed to the wild swings.

South Korea has already suspended new listings of single-stock leveraged ETFs earlier this month.

'Divorced from reality'

Kospi's decline extends a volatile stretch for South Korean equities following an extraordinary AI-fueled rally. The benchmark index more than tripled from the start of 2025 to its mid-June peak before retreating about 40%.

"Large daily fluctuations are mostly divorced from market fundamentals," Eurasia Group analysts wrote in a note on Tuesday.

While corporate profits remain at record highs, institutional and foreign investors have increasingly taken profits as more retail investors have entered the market, they added.

SK Hynix's reaction echoes recent trading in other chip heavyweights. Samsung Electronics shares fell after the company forecast a 19-fold increase in quarterly operating profit earlier this month. Shares of Taiwan Semiconductor Manufacturing Co. also declined following its record second-quarter results

SK Kim, a senior analyst at Daiwa Capital Market, told Bloomberg TV on Wednesday that the earnings miss had largely been anticipated and reflected product mix rather than weakening demand.

Instead, investors had been looking for additional shareholder returns, such as a buyback, after an "overdone" correction in SK Hynix's share price, Kim said.

"Fundamentally, there's no change in the AI-driven supercycle," he said.

作者：Huileng Tan 您目前正在关注该作者！ 想要取消关注吗？ 通过电子邮件中的链接取消订阅。

557% 的利润增长不足以让 SK 海力士投资者满意，这突显出人们对处于人工智能热潮核心的公司抱有多么高的期望。

这家韩国存储芯片制造商的股价下跌了 20%，收盘时下跌了近 10%，此前该公司公布了创纪录的第二季度盈利，但低于分析师的预期。

SK海力士公布营收为79.3万亿韩元，约合546亿美元，同比增长257%。 营业利润猛增 557% 至 60.5 万亿韩元，净利润猛增 1,242% 至 93.9 万亿韩元。 这三项均创下季度记录。

纳斯达克上市的 SK 海力士 ADR 周二收盘下跌 9%，在凌晨 4:00 的盘前交易中下跌约 4%。 美国东部时间周三。

该公司受益于价格上涨以及对高带宽内存（HBM）和人工智能服务器中使用的其他芯片的强劲需求。 尽管如此，收入和营业利润仍低于分析师的预期，营业利润低于约 64 万亿韩元的共识预测。

该指数权重股的抛售导致韩国基准综合股价指数下跌约 6%，而竞争对手三星电子的股价下跌约 5%。

随着投资者重新评估人工智能驱动的高估值，这种疲软蔓延到了整个亚洲的芯片股。 日本铠侠 (Kioxia) 下跌 14%，台积电 (Taiwan Semiconductor Manufacturing Co.) 下跌 14%。 最终下跌约 4%。

韩国当局计划于周三晚间召开紧急会议，审查市场波动情况。

当天早些时候，该国财政部长和最高金融监管机构就引入单一股票杠杆ETF而致歉，该ETF导致了剧烈波动。

韩国本月早些时候已暂停新的单股杠杆 ETF 上市。

“脱离现实”

在人工智能推动的非凡反弹之后，韩国综合股价指数的下跌延续了韩国股市的波动区间。 从 2025 年初到 6 月中旬的峰值，该基准指数上涨了两倍多，然后回落了约 40%。

欧亚集团分析师周二在一份报告中写道：“每日大幅波动大多与市场基本面脱节。”

他们补充说，尽管企业利润仍处于历史高位，但随着更多散户投资者进入市场，机构和外国投资者越来越多地获利了结。

SK 海力士的反应与其他芯片巨头最近的交易相呼应。 三星电子本月早些时候预测季度营业利润将增长 19 倍，导致该公司股价下跌。 台积电股份 在创纪录的第二季度业绩后也出现下滑

大和资本市场高级分析师 SK Kim 周三对彭博电视台表示，盈利低于预期主要是在预料之中，反映的是产品结构，而不是需求疲软。

Kim 表示，在 SK 海力士股价“过度”调整后，投资者一直在寻求额外的股东回报，例如回购。

“从根本上来说，人工智能驱动的超级周期没有变化，”他说。

Huileng Tan 是驻新加坡的资深记者，报道市场、全球经济、大宗商品和投资。 她的报道重点关注货币、人口、技术和政策的变化如何重塑世界各地的商业、财富和日常生活。自 2021 年加入《商业内幕》以来，她报道了从大宗商品繁荣和投资者趋势到中国经济、人工智能贸易以及推动全球市场的力量等方方面面。在加入《商业内幕》之前，她曾为 CNBC、道琼斯、安迅思和《华尔街日报》进行报道。2018 年和 2019 年，她赢得了新加坡交易所因其对全球大宗商品和衍生品市场的报道而荣获 Orb 年度故事奖 - 衍生品。请通过 htan@businessinsider.com 与她联系。
